site_title: Murmur · Ambient sound mixer for Windows
site_description: Layer rain over a fireplace, or a train over white noise. A free, open-source ambient sound mixer for Windows.
hero_sub: Play ambient sounds while you work, read, or fall asleep. Layer rain over a fireplace and save the blend.
hero_meta: Free · GPLv3 · No telemetry · Windows 10 and 11
feature_layer_sub: A storm over a coffee shop
feature_presets_sub: Every slider back where you left it
feature_import_sub: An audio file, or a YouTube link
feature_tray_title: Closes to the tray, keeps playing
feature_tray_sub: Your media keys still work, and it can launch at startup
download_reqs: Runs on Windows 10 (build 19041 or later) and Windows 11, on x64 and ARM64.
download_soon: No build published yet? Watch the {link} to hear when v1.0.0 lands.
cert_lead: The first install asks you to trust a certificate. Updates after that are a double-click.
cert_download_body: Grab {file} from the release you’re installing.
cert_trust_body: Install it to Local Machine → Trusted People. Windows asks for admin approval.
cert_note: A Microsoft Store release may remove this step later.
involved_contribute_body: The code is on GitHub. Pull requests welcome.
involved_feedback_body: Report a bug or suggest a sound on the issue tracker.
footer_blurb: Murmur is a free, open-source ambient sound mixer for Windows and the web.
footer_base: GPLv3 · No telemetry, no account, no ads
